description: A search box above the Svelte 5 data grid that filters the rows and wraps the matching substring in every cell with <mark>. The filtered row set is a $derived of the query, and text columns render through a cell snippet that splits the value around the match, so users see exactly why a row matched, with pagination still on.

faq.question: How do I highlight the matching text in a cell?
faq.answer: Render the column through a cell snippet that finds the query in the value, splits it into before, match and after, and wraps the match in <mark>. The snippet re-runs whenever the query changes.

faq.question: Where does the filtering happen?
faq.answer: Outside the grid, in a $derived that keeps the rows whose searchable fields contain the query, and that array is passed as data. filterMode is 'none' so the built-in filters do not compete with it.

faq.question: Is the match case-sensitive?
faq.answer: No. The demo lowercases both sides for the test and uses the original value for display, so the highlight keeps the cell's casing.
